Urls.//: Origin used to build absolute attachment URLs. Left empty so URLs stay root-relative; set it (e.g. https://localhost:7067) when the API is served from a different origin than the front end.

Jwt.//: Signs the admin access token. The key below is a development placeholder that ships with the repository — replace it (user-secrets, an environment variable, or a real appsettings file that is never committed) before deploying anywhere.

AdminSeed.//: The single admin account, created on startup only when no account with this email exists yet. Changing the password here later has no effect; the stored hash wins.

Attachments.//: Server-side rules for every uploaded file. The client only ever sends the bytes.
